title: The Hoodienauts
summary:
The Hoodienauts



● Hoodwink - Acorn Shot: The Boomerang has been reworked to Acorn Shot.
● Shadow Fiend - Requiem of Souls: Now, every 2 layers of demonic power will add an additional +1 shadow energy (originally every 1 layer).
● Human - Spark of Mind: Now directly grants 2/6 experience points to the courier (originally gained 1/3 Knowledge Books)
● Goblins - Nanobots: (3) Goblins now target random melee allies (previously random allies).
● New Items: Force Staff (T1), Hand of Midas(T2)
● Modified Items: Spider Legs(T3), Prince's Knife(T2)

Click the title link to check the full update details!
